section_summary.extract_value: This section, 'Applied Implications', discusses the practical implications of the study's findings for organizations. It suggests that fostering proactive work role performance can be achieved by considering self-leadership strategies and learning orientation in human resource management practices. The section highlights that self-leadership behavior-focused strategies mediate the effect of learning orientation on proactive work role performance and recommends considering all self-leadership strategies during training.
